claims.summary: Each sacrificed artifact is paid as a cost, giving Atog +2/+2 through end of turn. From 1/2, two sacrifices make it 5/6. Sacrificing an artifact land does not make another land drop available. On an unblocked Atog with opponent at five, sacrificing two artifact permanents during combat makes a 5/6 that can deal lethal five combat damage. The artifacts are sacrificed immediately as activation costs, so removing Atog in response does not bring them back.
